outcome: Open one work item and read its history
acceptance_criteria: **W-1004 (A-WORKITEM)** shows the six facts as separate boxes: Drafted, Reviewed and Approved Earned with times; Sent "Not yet"; Receipt recorded "Unknown"; Verified "Not yet". No box is empty or reads 0, and the Paid note is present. — verify: unit test renders the W-1004 fixture and asserts six list items, the exact texts, and no fact text matching `^$|^0$`. Also open http://localhost:3201/work/W-1004 with the mock on 3202 and look.
**Unknown or missing facts** always read "Unknown". — verify: unit test with every fact `unknown`, and with a facts array missing `sent`, asserts "Unknown" for each and never "0", "No" or blank.

**The state tag** shows the CMP-05 wording and colour class for all 11 states. — verify: a table-driven unit test over the 11 enum values asserts the text and the `psl-tag--*` class from the Contract table.

**The station track** shows every station from `stations[]` in order, with number, name and mapped status. The current one has `aria-current="step"`. At 390px only the track scrolls sideways. — verify: unit test for the 7 status mappings. The e2e at 390px asserts `document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 390` on /work/W-1001.
**The agent card never offers a decision.**

**Reduced motion:** the current agent step pulses only when motion is allowed. — verify: the e2e runs with `reducedMotion: 'reduce'` and asserts the current step's computed `animation-name` is `none`.
**Decision link only when the person can act:**

**Next step:** `next_step` appears in a callout of the mapped kind. effect_uncertain (W-1005) shows a warning callout and no action button anywhere on the page. — verify: unit test on W-1005 asserting the `psl-callout--warning` class and zero buttons outside the tabs and Try-again controls.
**Sample label:** "SAMPLE DATA" shows on the item when `sample: true`, even with `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_MODE=live`. — verify: unit test with the env stubbed to `live`.

**No access (403/404):** a 404 or a 403 shows "You can't open this work item" with "Back to my queue" to /my-work. Neither the id nor any title appears. — verify: open http://localhost:3201/work/W-1099 and see the permission view. Unit tests with fetch stubbed to 403 and to 404 assert that the requested id string is absent from `document.body.textContent`.
**401:** a 401 on the item shows the shell's signed-out callout with a sign-in link whose `next` is `/work/W-1001`. — verify: unit test.

**Server or network error:** shows the work-item error card with "Reference <code> for support." and Try again. Clicking Try again re-fetches and then shows the item. — verify: unit test where the first fetch returns 500 and the second returns 200.

**History (A-HISTORY):** /work/W-1004/history lists rows in the order returned (newest first), each with when in WAT, a PERSON/AGENT/FACTORY tag, actor and event. The list includes a return and an approval. — verify: unit test against the W-1004 history fixture asserts the row order equals the fixture order, and that `2026-11-12T15:40:00Z` renders as "12 Nov 16:40".

**Restricted history rows:** a restricted row shows only when, the actor-kind tag, the actor and "Restricted". Its event, detail and version strings never appear. — verify: unit test with a restricted item that does carry `event`, `detail` and `version` asserts those strings are absent.

**History is read-only:** the history view contains no input or button that edits or deletes an entry. Its only controls are the filter, the rows-per-page select, Show more and Try again. — verify: unit test enumerating the controls.

**Filter and paging requests:** choosing "Decisions" sends `kind=decisions&limit=20`. Choosing 10 rows sends `limit=10`. "Show more" sends `cursor=<next_cursor>` and appends rows. Show more is absent when the response has no `next_cursor`. — verify: unit test inspecting the stubbed `fetch` request URLs. In the browser, /work/W-1004/history with 10 rows shows 10 rows, then 12 after Show more, and no Show more after that.
**Mock: per-id selection with fallback.**

**Every fixture is schema-valid:** every file in `frontend/mock/fixtures/work/` (with `_kind` stripped) validates against the v3 E-WORK-ITEM or E-WORK-HISTORY 200 schema. — verify: a new test iterating the directory with the existing Ajv setup.
**Polling (D-UPDATES r2):**
**Accessibility (A-ACCESSIBILITY):** axe reports no WCAG 2.2 AA violations, and keyboard focus shows the focus ring on the tabs, filter and Show more. Pages and states checked:
**Gate:** `delivery/checks.sh` passes (lint, typecheck, vitest, next build). — verify: the gate run.

risk.rationale: I rated it medium, not low. It renders several cross-layer contract shapes (11 states, 7 station statuses, 4 fact statuses, restricted history). It carries rules that must not be weakened in the UI: INV-FACTS, INV-UNKNOWN, INV-AGENT and INV-RESTRICTED (`architecture/packages/v3/handoff.md`, Invariants). It also has to share `frontend/mock/server.mjs` and the E-WORK-ITEM fixture with two parallel features (PMO-0-3). It is not high: it is read-only, holds no money logic, identity or migrations, writes nothing, and runs locally on the mock. Surfaces: - `ui`: SCR-02 and the history view. - `api`: it consumes two contract operations through the generated client and extends the contract mock. The surfaces exclude `contract-change` because openapi.json is not edited; the gaps in PMO-0-1 and PMO-0-2 go to architecture. They exclude `auth` because the page only reacts to 401, 403 and 404. Product acceptance is not required. The work conforms to the client-approved SCR-02 boards and adds no new flow, copy or business rule. Omitting design values that the contract lacks is conformance, not new behaviour.
